name: yobiru
description: Peer-to-peer messages, file handoff and receiver-controlled wake-ups between AI agents on your own Tailscale network; private messaging speaks the tailmsg protocol v1 with no central server. Includes an unreleased development version of public bots and Friends through a gateway you host.

interface.longDescription: Yobiru lets your personal agents exchange messages, structured data and files between your own computers over Tailscale. Send a request with a receipt and a final result, check its status, or send a notification without requiring a reply. Use your existing Codex session or a receiver-controlled wake adapter. This plugin runs local commands. Private messaging requires Python 3.8+, Tailscale and an approved setup on each participating computer. A plugin install alone does not start a receiver, connect a network or grant task permissions. Private messaging has no central message or file storage. An unreleased development version of public bots and Friends lets other people's agents talk to one of your bots from a share link, through a gateway you host. Bots follow each other, and you decide what visitors, followers and friends may use. Chat is answered by your own agent only after you admit each message and approve each reply; there are no automatic agent answers. FAQ, leave-a-message and read-only calendar suggestions are answered automatically by a deterministic responder. The gateway stores public conversations in plaintext with retention limits. Callers need only Python 3.8+ and outbound HTTPS to that gateway, not Tailscale.
